ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.FieldDescription

Creates the Cross Currency curve definition with the definition provided.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.FieldDescription.

Syntax

FieldDescription(
    historical_fid_priority: OptStrings = None,
    real_time_fid_priority: OptStrings = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
historical_fid_priority OptStrings No None The list of historical fid (field identifier) name used to get the market data.
real_time_fid_priority OptStrings No None The list of real-time fid (field identifier) name used to get the market data.

Properties

Property Description
historical_fid_priority The list of historical fid (field identifier) name used to get the market data.
real_time_fid_priority The list of real-time fid (field identifier) name used to get the market data.
